bugs.summary: InlineTextEditor Tab saved/unmounted current editor before searching its sibling, so focus stayed behind. Native Chromium reproduced; resolving target before save and clicking after accepted outcome fixes forward navigation.
Drag onDrop relied on frame-throttled hover events; sampling final drop location before committing makes native pointer drop deterministic. Native Chromium verifies final order and cursor cleanup.
readLookupPreviewData returned unexpected internal Error.message to the browser. Red regression exposed private connection detail; stable retry message now preserves telemetry and hides private text.

Required case-data resume omitted requested searchAnswers in both controller activation branches, emptying no-matches registration defaults. New fully admitted sync/worker regressions failed old source and now preserve the search snapshot through initial arrival and later refresh suspension.

Both FormEngine default evaluators treated evaluated text false as no default, so an authored text literal silently disappeared. Fully admitted sync/worker test fails before fix; now only empty string means absent.

Generic case filter/sample/submission error mappers exposed unexpected internal messages. Three synthetic credential regressions fail old source; stable retry messages now preserve typed domain errors and server telemetry.

bugs: Eleven remaining caseDataBinding Server Action generic catches returned raw internal Error.message. Reproduced all11 with synthetic credential/host exception; now stable retry copy, preserving typed error arms and telemetry.

bugs.summary: Rename preflight request remained current after hook unmount and returned an obsolete success to its awaiting caller. Real session-store regression fails old source; effect cleanup now retires request generation.

AddressSearch accepted a held old Places response after query clear or during next debounce, restoring obsolete suggestions. Actual Base UI regression failed old source; immediate generation invalidation fixes it.

CaseListScreen kept selection validation current after unmount, allowing a delayed check to publish an obsolete target and navigate. Controlled pre-fix regression failed; unmount now retires its token.

CaseListScreen selection checks leaked transport rejections out of the click handler without retry guidance. Controlled rejection failed old source; current attempt now renders stable retry copy and retains choices, and retry succeeds.

Native Escape and outside-canvas drag completion emitted onDrop with empty targets and committed the prior hovered landing. Adapter now cancels absent/unrecognized final targets and retains prior landing only for real registered drop-placeholder.
